slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: Good technology still needs clear rules

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Technology is only as effective as the processes behind it. When documentation is missing, staff create informal workarounds, and those inconsistencies gradually increase security risk and make everything harder to manage.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: We help businesses across the UK replace guesswork with clear, practical policies, so people know what’s expected, and technology is managed consistently across every team.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Policies are written to fit how your business genuinely operates, so they hold up under audit rather than sitting unread in a folder. WhizzIT is Cyber Essentials certified and a Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider, so our security fundamentals are independently assessed rather than simply claimed. It is priced per user at a fixed monthly cost rather than bundled into rigid packages, so it scales with your team. Everything runs through the same UK service desk that handles your day-to-day tickets, so there is no separate team to chase.
